title: CardCorpus eras
description: Every era, each with its sets in order. An era is a run of sets that share a game generation and a card design, the way collectors group them: "Sword & Shield" holds the sets from Sword & Shield (2020) until Scarlet & Violet began, "Neo Series" the sets from Neo Genesis to Neo Destiny. Each catalog has its own eras, since the Japanese sets group differently: the English "Original Series" and the Japanese "Original Era" are two eras. A set names its era in its `era`.

eraCount.description: How many eras; always present, 0 included.

eras.description: Every era: the English ones oldest first, then the Japanese, the Simplified Chinese and the French.

catalog.description: The catalog whose sets it groups.

id.description: Its id: its catalog, then a slug kept when the era is renamed ("english/original-series").

name.description: Its name, as collectors say it, in its catalog's language where its sets name it so: "Sword & Shield", "e-Card Series", "Épée et Bouclier" (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#names).

englishName.description: Its name in English, where `name` is another language's: "Sword & Shield" beside "Épée et Bouclier".

position.description: Its place among its catalog's eras, oldest lowest. Sort by it; the numbers leave gaps (300, 400, 500).

sets.description: Every set of the era, in its catalog's order (sets/{catalog}.json).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `set`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).
